errors.LENDER_REPAYMENT_EXCEEDS_OWED: {amount} EGP is more than is owed: {owed} is left, which {settling} EGP pays off at {rate}.
errors.LENDER_REPAYMENT_CLEARS_NOTHING: {amount} EGP at {rate} clears nothing of the debt.
errors.LENDER_DEBT_OUTSTANDING: Cycle {cycle} cannot be settled while it still owes: {owed}. Repay them first.
errors.CYCLE_HAS_LENDER_FINANCING: Cycle {cycle} has an order a friend paid for; remove his payment before cancelling it.
errors.CYCLE_CLOSED_FOR_FINANCING: Cycle {cycle} is {status}; a friend's payment cannot be recorded on it.
errors.LENDER_ALREADY_FINANCES_ORDER: {lender} already paid for {reference}. Remove that and record it again to change it.
errors.FINANCING_EXCEEDS_ORDER: {amount} {currency} is more than is left to pay on {reference}: the order is {total} {currency} and friends already paid {financed}.
errors.FINANCING_HAS_REPAYMENTS: {lender} has been repaid on this; reverse those repayments before removing it.
errors.ACCOUNT_NOT_USABLE: {account} is not an active account in EGP; a repayment leaves one in pounds.
errors.LENDER_REPAYMENT_BEFORE_FINANCING: He paid the supplier on {paidOn}; a repayment cannot be dated before that.
errors.LENDER_REPAYMENT_ALREADY_REVERSED: This repayment was already reversed. Reversing again would count it twice.
errors.LENDER_CYCLE_SETTLED: Cycle {cycle} is settled; reverse the settlement before undoing a repayment on it.
errors.LENDER_NOTHING_OWED: {lender} is owed nothing on this, so there is nothing to schedule.
errors.LENDER_NOT_OWED: {lender} is owed nothing, so there is nothing to repay.
errors.LENDER_CURRENCY_MISMATCH: {reference} is in {orderCurrency}; what a friend paid for it is recorded in {orderCurrency}, not {currency}.
errors.LENDER_PLAN_EXISTS: This already has an active plan. Cancel it before agreeing another.
errors.LENDER_PLAN_EXCEEDS_OWED: The instalments total {total} {currency} but only {owed} is owed.
errors.FINANCING_ORDER_EMPTY: {reference} has no lines, so there is nothing a friend could have paid for.
errors.DEPARTURE_EXCEEDS_WAITING: Only {waiting} of {line} are waiting to leave, so a departure of {asked} cannot be recorded.
errors.DEPARTURE_BEFORE_ORDER: {line} was ordered on {orderedOn}, so it cannot have left on {day}.
errors.DEPARTURE_BEFORE_ARRIVAL: Only {available} of {line} had reached the start of {leg} and not left by {day}, so {asked} cannot have left that day.
errors.DEPARTURE_IN_USE: This departure cannot be undone: goods from it were delivered or marked lost, or the cycle has moved on because of it.
errors.DELIVERY_BEFORE_GOODS_LEFT: Only {available} of {line} had left on {leg} by {day}, so a delivery of {asked} that day cannot be recorded.
errors.LEG_HAS_SEVERAL_DEPARTURES: {leg} left in {departures} departures, so its date cannot be changed here. Undo the wrong departure on the cycle page and record it again.
errors.LEDGER_CATEGORY_NOT_MANUAL: “{category}” is not a category a manual entry can use. Choose one from the list.
errors.LEDGER_DIRECTION_MISMATCH: This is {kind}, so it cannot be recorded as {direction}.
errors.LEDGER_TYPE_NOT_MANUAL: A {type} entry is written by its own flow, not by hand.
errors.LEDGER_AMOUNT_NOT_POSITIVE: An amount must be more than zero.
errors.LEDGER_RATE_NOT_POSITIVE: The rate from {currency} to EGP must be more than zero.
errors.LEDGER_EGP_RATE: An amount in pounds converts to pounds at 1.
errors.LEDGER_CYCLE_REQUIRED: {category} is a cost of one cycle’s goods — choose the cycle it belongs to.
errors.LEDGER_CYCLE_NOT_OPEN: Cycle {cycle} is {status}, so nothing more can be charged to it.
errors.TRANSFER_SOURCE_NOT_SELLING: Cycle {cycle} is {status}. Leftovers can be moved only from a cycle that is selling or being settled.
errors.TRANSFER_SOURCE_PAID: Cycle {cycle} has been paid out; its stock can no longer move.
errors.TRANSFER_SOURCE_NOT_ACCOUNTED: Cycle {cycle} still has {onTheWay} unit(s) on the way and {waiting} delivered but not received; account for every unit before moving leftovers.
errors.TRANSFER_TARGET_CLOSED: Cycle {cycle} is {status} and cannot take stock in.
errors.TRANSFER_SAME_CYCLE: Leftovers cannot be moved from {cycle} to itself.
errors.TRANSFER_QTY_NOT_POSITIVE: The quantity of {product} to move must be more than zero.
errors.TRANSFER_MORE_THAN_ON_SHELF: Only {available} of {product} can be moved; {requested} was asked for.
errors.TRANSFER_DUPLICATE_PRODUCT: {product} is listed twice; give one quantity per product.
errors.TRANSFER_NO_LINES: Say how many of which product to move.
errors.TRANSFER_ALREADY_UNDONE: This move has already been undone.
errors.TRANSFER_UNITS_SOLD: Some of the {product} moved to {cycle} has been sold or used there; the move is permanent now.
errors.CYCLE_HAS_TRANSFERS_IN: Cycle {cycle} holds leftover stock moved in from another cycle; undo that move before cancelling it.
errors.LEDGER_CATEGORY_RESERVED: Moving leftover stock between cycles is recorded from the cycle page, not as a ledger entry.
errors.RUNNING_COST_CHARGED: This running cost was already taken from a payout ({cycles}). Reverse that settlement first, then this entry.

orderRequests.empty: Nothing is waiting for an answer.
orderRequests.notePlaceholder: Say what changed and why, if anything did.

orderRequests.changedWarning: This differs from what was asked for. The shop will see both figures — a note explaining why saves them asking.
orderRequests.emptyHint: When a shop orders from the storefront, its request waits here for an answer.

importRequests.title: Import requests
importRequests.subtitle: Parts shops have asked us to bring in.
importRequests.replyPlaceholder: What you found, what it costs, when it lands.

importRequests.emptyHint: When a shop asks for a part we do not stock, the request lands here.

push.title: Alerts on this device
push.deviceScope: A subscription belongs to one browser on one device. Turning alerts on here does nothing for your other devices, and turning them off does not silence them either.
push.intro: Get an alert when a shop asks to buy or asks for an import, even when this app is closed.
push.on: Alerts are on for this device.
push.failed: Alerts could not be turned on for this device.
push.installToGetAlerts: To get alerts on this iPhone, add MotoParts Manager to your home screen first — Safari cannot send them otherwise.
push.alertsBlockedTitle: Alerts are blocked for this site. The browser will not ask again, so turn them on here:
push.iosStep1: Tap the Share button at the bottom of Safari
push.iosStep2: Scroll down and tap "Add to Home Screen"
push.iosStep4: Open MotoParts Manager from your home screen and come back to this page
push.installStep1: Install MotoParts Manager from your browser menu — look for "Install app" or "Add to Home screen"
push.installStep2: Open it from your home screen and come back to this page
push.blockedIosStep1: Open Settings, then Apps, then Safari
push.blockedIosStep2: Tap Notifications and allow them for this site
push.blockedIosStep3: Come back here and press the button again
push.blockedSafariStep1: In the menu bar: Safari → Settings → Websites → Notifications
push.blockedSafariStep2: Find this site, set it to Allow, then press the button again
push.blockedFirefoxStep1: Click the padlock in the address bar, then open Permissions
push.blockedFirefoxStep2: Set Notifications to Allow, reload, then press the button again
push.blockedChromeStep1: Click the padlock or the icon at the start of the address bar
push.blockedChromeStep2: Set Notifications to Allow, reload, then press the button again

claudeConnections.title: Claude connections
claudeConnections.intro: Each Claude app you sign in — the phone, a laptop — is its own connection. Disconnecting one ends its access at once, without changing your password.
claudeConnections.empty: Claude is not connected to your account.
claudeConnections.howTo: To connect, open Claude, go to Settings → Connectors, add a custom connector, and paste this server URL. Claude will ask you to sign in with your usual login.
claudeConnections.confirmAll: Every Claude app signed in to your account loses access now. To use one again, you will have to sign it in again.
claudeConnections.failed: Could not disconnect. Please try again.
claudeConnections.loadFailed: Your Claude connections could not be loaded.
